div.p: Anti-patterns this shape rules out: a Vec<ConsumerRecord> inside CompletedFetch, Bytes::copy_from_slice where slice would do, a fresh String topic per record, per-record tokio::spawn.

g.text: FetchRequestManager — one FetchRequest per fetchable node

text.tspan: + topic_arc: Arc<str> allocated ONCE per fetch

g.text: FetchBuffer (Arc, shared with the app side)

text.tspan: BatchCursor — lazy, one record at a time
buffer is MOVED into MemoryRecords, never cloned
compressed batch decompressed ONCE into an owned buffer
